labels.raw_data_evidence: Low movement intervals recorded daily; no posture sensor data available.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Daytime activity present; no outdoor exposure data recorded.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No social preference or motivational barrier data recorded.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No screen or light exposure information recorded in wearable data.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No pre-bed routine or relaxation difficulty reported.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Steps stable ~8000 across both periods; no declining routine movement observed.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No caffeine intake timing or amount recorded.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Sleep pattern changed in window; no diary data available.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No nap information recorded in the wearable data.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No workplace layout or desk work context recorded.

labels.raw_data_evidence: All activity intervals have intensity marked as unknown.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No shift work or caffeine use established in the data.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No meal timing or size data recorded.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Steps stable ~8000; no reported time barrier to activity.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Activity intensity is unknown for all intervals.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Steps and activity present daily; no guideline compliance assessment possible without intensity.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Low movement intervals ~45 min each during daytime; no posture confirmation.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No health concerns or symptoms reported in the data.

labels.raw_data_evidence: HRV RMSSD values range 43-47 ms across both periods with minimal change.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Activity intervals at 20:30-22:00 precede sleep starting ~22:35-22:46 on same calendar date.
